headline: Moderna and Merck report success in late-stage personalized mRNA vaccine trial
summary: A personalized mRNA cancer vaccine combined with Keytruda reduced the risk of melanoma recurrence or death by 42% in a late-stage trial, though Moderna's shares fell.
why: Phase 3 clinical trial results for oncology vaccines dictate future revenue pipelines and regulatory milestones for major biotechnology firms.

impacts.name: Moderna Inc.
impacts.why: Despite positive clinical data, shares dropped as investors weighed unproven overall survival metrics and pending approval timelines.

why_moved: Market sentiment reacted to questions regarding overall survival data and commercial approval timelines despite successful recurrence-free survival endpoints.
